newsitem.title: USA: NGC to buy back shares for option program.
newsitem.headline: NGC to buy back shares for option program.

text.p: NGC Corp plans to buy back up to 1.6 million of its common shares for its employee stock option program, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Chuck Watson said on Wednesday.
"We're going to buy back up to 1.6 million shares," Watson said after the company's annual meeting here.
The purchases will be made from time to time on the open market, a company spokeswoman said. The company issues a similar amount of shares each year in the option program, she said.
Watson said "it's a little to early to call" when asked after the meeting whether the company would meet analysts' First Call estimates of $0.15 to $0.27 a share earnings for the second quarter.
The company posted what Watson at the time termed "dismal" first quarter net income of $4.6 million or $0.03 a share, down from $30.3 million or $0.26 a share in the same period last year.
The first quarter results included an $0.08 a share charge tied to its natural gas liquids business and a $0.05 a share reserve on a storage project investment, among other things.
"Notwithstanding the first quarter results, I'm very confident about the balance of 1997," Watson said in the meeting.
